digest.component_or_area: LLM model selection and fallback routing
propositions: A class with an unreachable model currently fails the gate outright; per-class fallback chains must allow transparent failover to inline fallback entries when the primary model is unavailable.

FallbackModel must be constructed from a class's fallback array with fallback_on set to a predicate derived from failure._RETRYABLE plus CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL, so that errors where provider switching helps (availability, rate limits) trigger failover but authentication and input errors propagate loudly.

Fallback entries must carry full endpoint configuration and be built through the same provider path as the primary; capabilities must be computed as the conservative intersection over all candidates before wrapping, and ran_model must be read from the returned ModelResponse, not the wrapper object.

All sub-model clients must be entered/exited through a single ProviderSession and registered on _closeables exactly once per entry, with pydantic-ai managing its own providers and rebar managing its own transports, to prevent double-close and leaks.

A 429 rate-limit must fall back but a 429 with insufficient_quota must not; a down local endpoint (httpx.ConnectError classified as RETRY_NOW) must fall back; 401/403 and 400 context-length errors must propagate without failover.
